status: Locked before inspecting new 2024/2025 outcomes in this extension. Retrospective out-of-time evaluation, not a prospectively deployed experiment.
fixed_model_origin: Original package, target-years 2011–2020 fitted history. Prior revision2/3 extensions never replace these models.
fixed_baselines: industry_mean learned from original training+validation targets through 2020
labour_covariates: Age 15–64, sex total, unemployment UNE_RATE/PT_LF_SUB and participation LF_RATE/PT_POP_SUB; no substitute for absent age band
features_2024: 170 region×industry rows at origin_year=2023 from original panel_all_rows_with_flags.csv; no target-year outcome read or used; prediction frozen and hashed before new outcomes access
features_2025: Only if complete official 2024 input features satisfy original definitions and source gate; require 2024 labour covariates for ages15–64; never substitute all-age indicators; freeze forecasts before scoring2025
feature_source_revisions: 2024 forecasts use ORIGINAL snapshot2023 origin features without refit or refresh. For 2025, the designated original source is required; original2022/2023 levels retained for historical lags only after gate confirms comparability.
comparison: All locked models reported; zero remains default reference; ridge remains original selected learned comparator. New score is never a criterion for data inclusion or model replacement.
aggregation: Report each target year separately. Pooled MAE gives each eligible region-industry-year equal weight; pooled wMAE uses origin-year employment. Report year-balanced mean as separate column if both years are eligible.
inference: With at most two new annual origins, do not calculate DM significance or claim independent repeated experiments. No new tuning or bootstrap significance assertion.
gate_before_any_scoring: official source with retrieval metadata and identifiers documented
17 original Korean region codes and their geography definitions match
10 original nonoverlapping broad industry groups and classifications match
employment units/multipliers and source measure are unchanged
observation time/frequency mapping to each OECD annual value is documented
age15–64 and sex-total labour covariate definitions match where used
2022 and2023 overlapping employment levels, shares, total employment, and required labour covariates compared
positive finite employment and exact key uniqueness; no outcome-size deletion
all target cells complete or explicit gate failure; do not select incomplete subset by observed forecast loss

overlap_rule.source: Compare new source2022/2023 with original snapshot at identical raw keys.
overlap_rule.numerical_equality_tolerance: atol=1e-8, rtol=1e-10 (floating representation only, not substantive revision allowance)
overlap_rule.revisions: Any substantive overlap difference stops scoring pending documented official revision/bridging evidence and a gate decision made without evaluating prediction losses. It is not automatically accepted by a permissive tolerance. Original input snapshot remains frozen.
overlap_rule.missing_overlap: FAIL unless official direct continuity evidence and scoped limitations are documented before scoring.
